Payment disputed. Emitted when a cardholder or issuer opens a dispute against
a previously successful payment. This is the first event in the dispute
sub-lifecycle; subsequent updates arrive as `payment.dispute.*`. Gather
evidence promptly — `evidence_due_by` in the payload is authoritative.
